title: Themes
metadata-files: 
  - _common.yml
---


```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Load standard init
source(here::here("_rinit.R"))

# Scope locale & timezone just for this script
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "en_US.UTF-8"))
invisible(Sys.setenv(TZ = "America/Los_Angeles"))

# Directory to search (current dir by default — change if needed)
root <- "."

# Collect *.qmd, drop extensions, and exclude unwanted names
themes <- tibble::tibble(
  theme = tools::file_path_sans_ext(
    list.files(path = root, pattern = "\\.qmd$", full.names = FALSE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )
) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !theme %in% c("api", "index", "themes"),
    !grepl("_update", theme, perl = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(theme)
```



# All

## Javascript

```{r, echo = F}
list <- themes %>%
  mutate(Title = read_lines(paste0(theme, ".qmd"), skip = 1, n_max = 1) %>% gsub("title: ", "", .) %>% gsub("\"", "", .)) %>%
  mutate(Compile = as.Date(file.info(paste0(theme, ".html"))$mtime),
         Compile = glue::glue("[{Compile}](https://fgeerolf.com/data/{theme}.html)")) %>%
  gt::gt()

list |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = "Compile") |>
  gt::opt_interactive(use_search = T, use_resizers = T, use_compact_mode = T)
```

## Flat

```{r, echo = F}
list |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = "Compile")
```
